items.headline: Your AI Startup’s Exit Is Being Shaped By The Deals You Sign Today
items.excerpt: When everything moves that fast, the terms of your financings and of your contracts for compute, data and distribution get set early and in a hurry. Some of those terms will later slow a sale, add cost and erode value.

items.headline: AI Bias In HR: Why Polished Work Gets Overrated And What to Do About It
items.excerpt: Employees and job-seekers alike are all using AI to create polished work and applications that appear perfect. In that environment, how can we promote and hire the right people?
